title: Fubini on the product plane π⁻¹(span τ) for compactly supported continuous f
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], Φ(s, u) := (s, u_1, …, u_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ u))), π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) ∈ ℝ^P (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))), and assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A), where Φ′(p) := Φ(p.1, p.2) on ℝ × ℝ^P and L¹ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ. Let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_m) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P (τ : Fin m → ℝ^P), T := span ℝ (range τ), and let f : ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Then ∫_{{z : π(z) ∈ T}} f dH^{m+1} = ∫_ℝ (∫_T f(Φ(σ, w)) dHᵐ(w)) dσ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))) → ∀ τ : Fin m → Eucl P, Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∀ f : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∫ z in {z : Eucl (P + 1) | ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ z))) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)}, f z ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) = ∫ σ : ℝ, ∫ w in (Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) : Set (Eucl P)), f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons σ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ w))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
